programs.title: Criminal Intent
programs.desc: Devon Major (Sebastian Spence) is charged with murdering his ex-wife after he finds her body in her house. He asks Susan Grace (Vanessa Angel), his wife's best friend and a former criminal lawyer, to defend him.

programs.title: Not With My Daughter
programs.desc: After learning that her client may be guilty, a defense attorney (Ally Sheedy) finds out that the man seduced her daughter as a ploy to save himself.

programs.title: Framed by My Fiancé
programs.desc: Following a deadly car crash in which her fiancé was driving, a woman wakes up to learn that she is being charged with manslaughter as the driver of the vehicle.

programs.title: Danger on Party Island
programs.desc: When a lawyer travels to an infamous island to collect her sister's body, she becomes suspicious of foul play. With help from a local bar owner, she begins to unravel the circumstances of her sister's accident and starts to believe she could be next.

programs.title: A Daughter's Deceit
programs.desc: Suzanne Cruz's perfect life as a mother, wife and lawyer is shattered by Cassie, who vows revenge on the lawyers who destroyed her family when she was a girl. Suzanne must learn who is tearing her life apart before Cassie comes in for the kill.

programs.title: My Wife's Secret Life
programs.desc: Kent devises a revenge plan against a woman whose husband ruined his marriage.
